cues: NEB uses Q equals delta U plus W, where W is the work done by the gas.
Some books write delta U equals Q plus W, where W is the work done on the gas.
Both are correct physics, but mixing them flips the sign of your answer.
Write down the NEB form at the start, and stick to it.
